sourceQuote: Two recommendation letters from associate professors or those with corresponding professional titles or above.Applicants who studied in China during their previous educational stage are required to provide proof of their performance at school.
targetQuote: 两封由副教授、具有相应专业技术职称或以上职务者出具的推荐信。上一教育阶段曾在中国学习者，须提供其在校表现证明。
